scope: Cross-check all 14 names in the already read ORC 2024 PhD thesis section against official MIT degree-recipient books; not a worldwide or independent programme census.
reviewMethod: Official name-book index opened in Chrome. Official PDFs opened/read with PDF reader, parsed relevant pages and rendered/visually inspected both full pages locally. Temporary full-page images removed after review; source documents were read in memory and not saved. PDF screenshot service returned no visible image; local rendering resolved the layout/annotation check.

limitations: Nine 2024-book entries have no individual month annotation; ceremony date is not assigned as their conferral date.
Five explicit September 2024 entries appear in 2025 ceremony book; 2025 is not their degree year.
Namebooks and ORC thesis section agree for these 14, but do not by themselves establish a complete independently enumerated calendar-year programme census across all administrative hosts.
September 2023 Kayla Cummings appears on the 2024 page but is outside this 2024 thesis source window and was not added.
No programme founding year, missing-year zero or uninterrupted historical provision inferred.
browserLimitation: Chrome PDF extension UI blocked further automation, including closing the Stage 4-created PDF tab. No extension settings or access controls changed. User must dismiss/complete the extension UI before more Chrome research; independent PDF checks and lane-file work continued.
